subject.title: Sessions report abortedLastRun=true without corresponding error trace in trajectory log

question: Should implementation begin from the source-proven lifecycle gap, or wait for one correlated current-main session record, trajectory export, and gateway log?
rationale: Source proves that abort markers and trajectory terminal events have separate writers, but the supplied production evidence uses legacy trajectory storage and an unclear binary-version pairing, so maintainer judgment is needed on the proof threshold before changing several lifecycle paths.

options.title: Require correlated current-main proof
options.body: Request an exact current binary version plus matching session ID, run ID, exported trajectory bundle, session record, timestamps, and gateway logs before scoping the repair.

options.title: Proceed from source evidence
options.body: Treat the independent abort-marker writers as sufficient evidence and immediately scope a unified typed abort-cause repair with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Require correlated current-main proof
recommendation.body: Request an exact current binary version plus matching session ID, run ID, exported trajectory bundle, session record, timestamps, and gateway logs before scoping the repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the canonical terminal-outcome, embedded-run, and session-control boundaries needed to decide whether source evidence is sufficient for a cross-path lifecycle change.
